name: experience-layer-phase-15-hint-injection
title: Experience Layer Phase 1.5: advisory review-time hint injection (experience-hint-loader + story-review advisory section + usage tracking), excluded from the reviewRunId promptHash domain
description: Implement Phase 1.5 from docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md: a core/experience-hint-loader.ts that ranks finding-signals by priority=signalScore*log(1+support)*recencyBoost, filters (recurring>=0.65; common-false-positive bucket) and formats top-N hints with progressive disclosure; surfaced as an advisory-only section in handlers/story-review.ts mirroring grillSection; with experience_hint_surfaced usage tracking via appendActivityLog. Load-bearing guardrail: hints are advisory-only and never affect the deterministic reviewRunId binding — resolveReviewPromptHash must stay independent of hint content. No gate logic changes. Proven by a smoke covering ranking/filter/top-N, advisory presence, usage event, and the promptHash determinism guardrail.
